## 1. Goal

Prove the project is reproducible: Ahaana follows only the README on her own laptop from a fresh clone and gets everything running in 15 minutes or less. Every step that stalls gets fixed in the README.

## 2. Background

**From PRD §1A M12:**

| # | Feature | Owner | Done when |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| M12 | Runs from a clean clone | Both | Other member follows the README on their own laptop in 15 minutes or less |

**From PRD §0 Success metrics:**

| Metric | Target |
| --- | --- |
| Fresh-clone setup | The other member gets the project running from the README in 15 minutes or less |

## 3. Scope

**In scope:**

- Timed fresh clone on Ahaana's laptop
- README fixes

**Out of scope:**

- Changing tools (K-18 rule: upgrade only when a bug forces it)

## 4. Files

| Path | Create / modify | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `README.md` | modify | Fixes found during the test |

## 5. Specification

Steps timed: clone; Python venv from the lock file; `make`; `make test`; open the website (built `aprm.js` from `make wasm` or CI); `python tools/plot_figures.py`.

## 6. Step-by-step tasks

1. Ahaana clones into a new folder
2. She follows the README alone while Krishna notes stalls
3. Fix the README
4. Repeat until ≤ 15 minutes

## 7. Tests to write

| Test name | What it checks | Expected result |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `timed-run` | Full setup from clone | ≤ 15 minutes, no help needed |

## 8. Acceptance criteria (Done when)

- [ ] Ahaana builds, runs `make test`, opens the website and regenerates figures in ≤ 15 minutes (M12)
- [ ] Every stall fixed in the README

## 9. How to verify

Record start and end times and each command's result in the PR.

## 10. Viva notes

**Idea:** if a teammate can't rebuild it from the instructions, neither can an examiner.
**Examiner question:** "Could I run this on my laptop?" — Yes: the README gets a fresh clone running in 15 minutes.

## 11. Pitfalls

- Krishna helping silently (defeats the test)
- Relying on files that exist only on Krishna's laptop

## 12. Assistant prompt

```
Read CLAUDE.md, then this issue (#34) in full.
Goal: Have Ahaana set up from a fresh clone using only README.md in ≤ 15 minutes, and fix every step that stalls.
Create the branch k/K-31-fresh-clone from an up-to-date main.
Write the tests in section 7 first, then implement in small commits (present tense, one idea each).
Run the commands in section 9 until everything is green.
Then explain the result in plain English for the viva, covering everything in section 10.
Fill in the PR from .github/pull_request_template.md, tick every box in section 8, and add a line to docs/AI_USE.md.
When CI is green, squash-merge the PR yourself and close the issue.
```
